answer: Submitting an answer locks 18 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The ripple escrow is released only against a opal receipt, and the nadir audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 216 aliases means carrying 124 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
